subject: Not displaying the legend when using scale_colour_manual or  scale_linetype_manual

messages.author: fa023ca25cfe4c63
messages.subject: Not displaying the legend when using scale_colour_manual or  scale_linetype_manual
parts:
Hello,

Is it possible to not display a legend when using scale_colour_manual
or scale_linetype_manual, and if so, how?

I tried this:
scale_colour_manual(values = c(red,gray),legend=NULL)

but got the error
"Error in !scale$legend : invalid argument type".

Thanks for your help,

Kim

messages.author: 70ab9fabb9f066d8
messages.subject: Re: Not displaying the legend when using scale_colour_manual or  scale_linetype_manual
parts:
Hi Kim,

You want "legend = FALSE". Eg.

qplot(1:10, 1:10, colour = rep(c("A","B"), each = 5)) +
scale_colour_manual(values = c("red", "grey"), legend = FALSE)

Charlotte
